color.description: A fitting complementary hex color for the main subject or main aspect of the image.

looking_towards_cardinal_direction_sente.description: A small sentence stating which cardinal direction the subject is staring in.

looking_towards_x.description: The x-coordinate within a unit square (float 0.0 to 1.0) showing the direction that the subject is staring in.

looking_towards_y.description: The y-coordinate within a unit square (float 0.0 to 1.0) showing the direction that the subject is staring in.
